ai-factory.notes: Validated against upstream 2.13.2 on the 2.x branch. AI Factory 2.13.x adds plan-aware /aif-commit Commit Plan grouping and the built-in /aif-distillation skill for turning books, docs, folders, or URLs into reusable Agent Skills.

openspec.notes: OpenSpec is used as an optional artifact protocol and CLI validation/archive adapter for v1. OpenSpec skills are not installed by this extension.
